title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models for Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.15344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the adaptation of pretrained language models to univariate time-series forecasting through a parameter-efficient transfer learning framework, with the goal of understanding which design choices drive effective cross-modal transfer. While language models operate on discrete textual tokens, time series consist of continuous numerical observations with temporal dependencies. To bridge this modality gap, we project fixed-length time-series patches directly into the embedding space of a pretrained GPT-2 backbone, bypassing textual tokenization and treating the Transformer as a generic sequence encoder. translated_title: 预训练语言模型在时间序列预测中的参数高效适配
translated_abstract: 我们研究了通过参数高效的迁移学习框架，将预训练语言模型适配到单变量时间序列预测任务，目标是理解哪些设计选择能够驱动有效的跨模态迁移。虽然语言模型处理的是离散的文本标记，但时间序列由具有时间依赖性的连续数值观测组成。为了弥合这一模态差距，我们将固定长度的时间序列补丁直接投影到预训练GPT-2主干的嵌入空间中，绕过文本标记化过程，将Transformer视为通用序列编码器。通过对涵盖能源、天气、交通和金融领域的七个基准数据集进行受控消融研究，我们分析了以下因素的影响：(i) 表示策略（连续嵌入与文本序列化）、(ii) 适配方式（冻结主干与部分或全部微调）、(iii) 架构组件，例如……（摘要内容在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出一种参数高效的迁移学习框架，将固定长度时间序列补丁直接投影到冻结的GPT-2嵌入空间中，以绕过文本标记化的方式将语言模型作为通用序列编码器，并通过七个基准数据集上的系统性消融实验，揭示了表示策略、适配方式和架构组件等设计选择如何影响语言模型向时间序列预测的有效跨模态迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a parameter-efficient transfer learning framework that directly projects fixed-length time-series patches into the embedding space of a frozen GPT-2 backbone, bypassing textual tokenization, and uses controlled ablation studies across seven benchmark datasets to identify which design choices—representation strategy, adaptation regime, and architectural components—drive effective cross-modal transfer from language models to time-series forecasting.
